text_block_list.text: —The day of the Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The weather has turned terribly stormy,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The track is heavily bogged down...
However, I cannot afford to flinch.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
For dirt Umamusume, this race is their "Japanese Derby"!
The decisive battleground of the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "If we can't make our presence felt here, we'll never be able to topple the JRA."
That she is the standout Umamusume among her peers. That is something she absolutely must prove.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
With this weather, there probably won't be much cheering.
Even so, we will...
Though I'm sure some girls will come to cheer♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san? Why...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Why, you ask? Of course I came to watch.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And me too, while we're at it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Espo-san.
...I see. You're right, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This race is an inter-league match between the JRA and local circuits.
The two of them are cheering for the JRA side...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Cut the crap!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Stop jumping to conclusions!
Central, Regional, who cares about that crap?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"We just came to watch because our friend is running.
That's all."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I don't really cheer for someone just because they're from the Central,
or root against them because they're from the Local circuit.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so?
I apologize..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
Man, the weather's terrible today though.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I believe genuine radiance will reach them.
Give it your all, Furioso-san."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Central or regional, it doesn't matter..."
When it's said straight to my face...
it leaves me with mixed feelings...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I understand that way of thinking, and I'm not denying it, but...
it's not something you can just easily accept, is it?
"Defeat the Central." That wasn't just a goal—it was the very driving force behind them.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I can achieve decent results
in this Japan Dirt Derby—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to do.
Next time, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
And in order to forge ahead toward that—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'll see this race through to the very end!
No matter how rough the road may be!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This Japan Dirt Derby
is one of our milestones. And—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll make this a stepping stone.
Toward the real challenge ahead!
